name: Camazepam
summary: A benzodiazepine drug that is stronger in terms of anxiety relief than it is in terms of how hypnotic it is. It is a metabolite of diazepam and has limited anticonvulsant properties.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet

pharmacology.text: Camazepam, like others benzodiazepines, produce a variety of therapeutic and adverse effects by binding to the benzodiazepine receptor site on the GABAA receptor and modulating the function of the GABA receptor, the most prolific inhibitory receptor within the brain. The GABA chemical and receptor system mediates inhibitory or calming effects of camazepam on the nervous system.

uses.text: Camazepam is indicated for the short-term treatment of insomnia and anxiety. As with other benzodiazepines, its use should be reserved for patients in which the sleep disorder is severe, disabling, or causes marked distress.

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, dizziness, poor coordination and memory problems. Like other benzodiazepines it can cause dependence, and stopping suddenly after regular use can cause severe withdrawal, including seizures. In overdose it can slow breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 常見作用包括嗜睡、頭暈、協調變差與記憶問題。和其他苯二氮平類藥物一樣，它可能造成依賴，規律使用後突然停藥可能引發嚴重的戒斷反應，包括癲癇發作。過量時可能抑制呼吸。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见作用包括嗜睡、头晕、协调制差与记忆问题。和其他苯二氮平类药物一样，它可能造成依赖，规律使用后突然停药可能引发严重的戒断反应，包括癫痫发作。过量时可能抑制呼吸。

fact.en: Camazepam is temazepam with a dimethylcarbamate group attached, and the body breaks it down into temazepam. Adding a group that the body later removes is a common way of changing how a drug is absorbed.
fact.zh: 卡馬西泮是在替馬西泮上接了一個二甲基胺甲酸酯基，人體會把它分解成替馬西泮。加上一個之後會被身體移除的基團，是改變藥物吸收方式的常見手法。
fact.zhHans: 卡马西泮是在替马西泮上接了一个二甲基胺甲酸酯基，人体会把它分解成替马西泮。加上一个之后会被身体移除的基团，是改变药物吸收方式的常见手法。
